try.value: Execute the Ansible playbook to stop the running Tomcat instance, back it up, upgrade it to the specified version, and ensure the new version is up and running.

inputs.name: playbook
inputs.value:
`
---
- name: Detect and Upgrade Tomcat
  hosts: ${$hostname}
  become: yes
  vars:
    target_version: ${JSON.stringify($previous_version)}
    new_tomcat_version: ${JSON.stringify($new_version)}
    base_version: ${JSON.stringify($base_version)}
    hostname: ${JSON.stringify($hostname)}
    tomcat_download_url: "https://archive.apache.org/dist/tomcat/tomcat-{{ base_version }}/v{{ new_tomcat_version }}/bin/apache-tomcat-{{ new_tomcat_version }}.tar.gz"
    backup_dir: "/opt/tomcat_backup"
    

  tasks:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Identify the running Tomcat process
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Get Tomcat process command line (cross-platform)
      shell: ps -ef | grep '[j]ava' | grep tomcat | head -n 1 || true
      register: tomcat_ps
      changed_when: false

    - name: Debug Tomcat process (for verification)
      debug:
        var: tomcat_ps.stdout

    - name: Warn if Tomcat is not running
      debug:
        msg: "Tomcat process not found — continuing upgrade (it will be treated as stopped)."
      when: tomcat_ps.stdout == ""

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. Extract CATALINA_HOME and stop Tomcat
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Extract CATALINA_HOME from process
      set_fact: 
        catalina_home: "{{ tomcat_ps.stdout | regex_search('-Dcatalina\\.home=([^\\s]+)', '\\1') | first }}"
      when: tomcat_ps.stdout != ""

    - name: Set default catalina_home if not detected
      set_fact:
        catalina_home: "/opt/tomcat"
      when: tomcat_ps.stdout == "" or catalina_home is not defined or catalina_home == ""

    - name: Debug extracted CATALINA_HOME
      debug:
        var: catalina_home
      
    - name: Stop Tomcat gracefully
      shell: "timeout 20 {{ catalina_home }}/bin/shutdown.sh || true"
      when: catalina_home is defined and catalina_home != ""

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Prepare backup paths
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Generate unique backup folder name
      set_fact:
        backup_dir: "{{ backup_dir }}/tomcat-{{ target_version }}-{{ ansible_date_time.iso8601_basic_short }}"

    - name: Ensure backup directory exists
      file:
        path: "{{ backup_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: '0755'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Backup current Tomcat installation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Backup existing Tomcat
      command: mv "{{ catalina_home }}" "{{ backup_dir }}"
      when: catalina_home is defined and catalina_home != ""
      become: yes
      changed_when: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5. Download and extract new Tomcat
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Download new Tomcat version
      get_url:
        url: "{{ tomcat_download_url }}"
        dest: "/tmp/apache-tomcat-{{ new_tomcat_version }}.tar.gz"
        timeout: 60
      register: download_result
      retries: 5
      delay: 10
      until: download_result is succeeded

    - name: Extract new Tomcat into target directory
      unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/apache-tomcat-{{ new_tomcat_version }}.tar.gz"
        dest: "{{ catalina_home | dirname }}"
        remote_src: yes

    - name: Remove downloaded archive
      file:
        path: "/tmp/apache-tomcat-{{ new_tomcat_version }}.tar.gz"
        state: absent

    - name: Rename extracted Tomcat to original catalina_home
      command: mv "{{ catalina_home | dirname }}/apache-tomcat-{{ new_tomcat_version }}" "{{ catalina_home }}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 6. Restore configuration, logs, webapps
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Restore configuration (conf)
      copy:
        src: "{{ backup_dir }}/tomcat/conf/"
        dest: "{{ catalina_home }}/conf/"
        mode: '0755'
        remote_src: true

    - name: Restore logs directory
      copy:
        src: "{{ backup_dir }}/tomcat/logs"
        dest: "{{ catalina_home }}/logs"
        mode: '0755'
        remote_src: true

    - name: Ensure webapps directory permissions
      file:
        path: "{{ catalina_home }}/webapps"
        recurse: yes
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Restore webapps directory
      copy:
        src: "{{ backup_dir }}/tomcat/webapps"
        dest: "{{ catalina_home }}/webapps"
        mode: '0755'
        remote_src: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 7. Ensure permissions & restart Tomcat
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Ensure bin scripts are executable
      file:
        path: "{{ catalina_home }}/bin"
        recurse: yes
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Start Tomcat
      shell: "nohup {{ catalina_home }}/bin/startup.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &"
      async: 5
      poll: 0

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 8. Verify Tomcat version and availability
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Check Tomcat version
      command: "{{ catalina_home }}/bin/catalina.sh version"
      register: tomcat_version
      changed_when: false

    - name: Display Tomcat version
      debug:
        msg: "Tomcat version: {{ tomcat_version.stdout }}"

    - name: Check if Tomcat default page is accessible
      uri:
        url: "http://{{ ansible_default_ipv4.address }}:8080"
        method: GET
        return_content: yes
        status_code: 200
        use_proxy: no
      register: tomcat_status
      retries: 6
      delay: 10
      until: tomcat_status.status == 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 9. Compare versions & set summary
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    - name: Extract installed Tomcat version
      set_fact:
        installed_version: "{{ tomcat_version.stdout | regex_search('Server version: Apache Tomcat/(\\S+)', '\\1') }}"

    - name: Determine patch status
      set_fact:
        patch_status: "{{ 'success' if installed_version[0] == new_tomcat_version and tomcat_status.status == 200 else 'failed' }}"

    - name: Build patch summary dictionary
      set_fact:
        patch_summary: >-
          {{
            { ansible_default_ipv4.address: {'status': patch_status} }
          }}

    - name: Display patch summary
      debug:
        var: patch_summary

`
